TC-22/S23.detail: Re-run 16:51 JST after review; all 4 runs fail on doneAt (as in 2-3 earlier runs each). Clock -24 h: doneAt = device time, 1440 min before server (Hospital 2026-10-13T07:51 vs server 2026-10-14T07:51; Nursing Home likewise). Clock +24 h: doneAt 1440 min after server. Retention after the list reload: Hospital -24 h - 'follow up BMP' is removed and not under Finished Tasks (judged, U13: Hospital completed tasks 16 h); Hospital +24 h kept. Nursing Home -24 h removed too, but that is recorded only: UAT 3.6 gives no retention for completed Nursing Home tasks (TC-22 Q12).
TC-22/S23.productIssue: On a device whose clock is a day off, a task closed by Save & Extract ('BMP came back…' closes 'follow up BMP') gets the device's time as doneAt, in Hospital and Nursing Home (useEncounterTasks.ts:145 and snf useSaveAndExtract.ts:62 stamp, used at :70, use new Date()): breaks UAT 3.8 in both contexts. Hospital: a day behind, the task vanishes from Task Export > Finished Tasks as soon as the list reloads; a day ahead, it would stay about 40 h instead of 16 h (UAT 3.6, U13). Nursing Home shows the same removal, but how long a completed Nursing Home task should stay is open (TC-22 Q12).
